title: Chance the 2026–2030 average exceeds 1.5°C

sources.label: WMO Global Annual-to-Decadal Update 2026–2030

note: 75% is the probability for the entire five-year average, shown at the end of the forecast window; it is not a temperature or an annual series. Temporary five-year exceedance is distinct from the Paris Agreement long-term warming threshold.

title: Projected decline in global homicide rate, 2015–2030

projection.label: United Nations Sustainable Development Goals Report 2026, Goal 16

sources.label: United Nations Sustainable Development Goals Report 2026, Goal 16
sources.quote: the global homicide rate in 2030 will be around one quarter lower than in 2015

note: Approximately 25% lower global intentional-homicide rate in 2030 relative to 2015 if current trends continue; a cumulative rate reduction, not a 25% annual decline, all-crime forecast or number of deaths. The source’s “one quarter” is represented as 25%. Regional trajectories vary; the target is not treated as achieved.

title: US Christian population share in 2070: Pew 2022 scenario

sources.label: Pew Research Center, 2022 steady-switching scenario
sources.quote: In 2070, 46% of Americans would identify as Christian

sources.label: Pew: Decline of Christianity in the U.S. Has Slowed, May Have Leveled Off

note: A conditional demographic scenario, explicitly not a prediction: religious switching and other assumptions remain at the rates used in Pew’s 2020 baseline. Includes children; not worldwide religious composition. This is a 2022 scenario, not a refreshed 2026 forecast. Pew’s February 2025 observations found that the US Christian decline had slowed or may have leveled off, so the old scenario should not be read as inevitable.

sources.quote: that could grow to as much as $4.4 billion by 2028

note: USD billions of worldwide quantum-computing company revenue. $4.4 billion is the published upper estimate (“as much as”), not a midpoint, guaranteed outcome or economic value enabled by quantum computing. The separate $60–100 billion 2035 internal quantum market has a broader scope and is not substituted here.
